about_the_game:
Welcome to EpiDexa Racing

EpiDexa Racing is an arcade racing game focused on time trials and competitive multiplayer. It’s designed for quick fun as well as high-level competition. Easy to play with a keyboard or controller – but mastering its tracks will truly push your skills to the limit.

 

Gameplay

Skill-focused racing
EpiDexa Racing is all about precision and fairness. In the core modes, cars cannot collide with each other – ensuring no opponent can ruin your race with unfair tactics. With finely tuned controls, every corner, every drift, and every millisecond truly matters.

All cars are only visually different – their driving behavior is identical. This means newcomers have the same chance to reach first place as the experts, keeping the competition fair and purely skill-based.

Track Design

Race across diverse environments such as towering mountains, tropical islands, and vast desert canyons. Each setting not only offers its own visual identity but also changes the way you drive – from road width to cornering style – ensuring every track feels unique and challenging.

 

Game modes

Singleplayer – Classic Time Trial mode: sharpen your skills, earn Bronze, Silver, and Gold medals, and climb the global leaderboards.

Public Multiplayer – Compete against players worldwide and improve your driver rating

Private Multiplayer – Create your own lobby and challenge your friends to see who’s the fastest.

Rumble Mode (planned) – A chaotic variant where collisions, nitro boosts, and items are allowed for maximum fun.

 

Features

  • Play your way – with precise controls on both keyboard and controller.

  • Race against your own ghost to improve consistency and perfect your runs.

  • Global leaderboards to test your skills against the world.

  • Dedicated servers – no splitscreen, no host advantage, just pure racing.

  • Private multiplayer lobbies for friends.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 1600 / Intel Core i5-9500
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050 / Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Processor: Ryzen 7 5700 / Intel Core i5-12600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3060 / Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Installation on an SSD noticeably reduces loading times.
